instruction: Fix `read_lines` so it returns each line intact instead of splitting on every whitespace character (which merges words across lines).
gold_patch:
diff --git a/fileops.py b/fileops.py
--- a/fileops.py
+++ b/fileops.py
@@ -6,7 +6,7 @@
 def read_lines(path):
     """Read a text file and return its lines without trailing newlines."""
     with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
-        return f.read().split()
+        return f.read().splitlines()
